test: All-language historical transformation-rule discovery — complete Wiktextract scan, 20 route shards, 5-fold held-out testing per route

design.scope: Every entry in the complete English Wiktionary Wiktextract stream is scanned. Every explicit inherited ancestor→descendant word relation with a usable meaning and 4×4 gate path is admitted; historical and proto-language codes are not excluded.
design.primary_test: For each language route, learn context-sensitive ancestor→descendant and descendant→ancestor gate transformations on four folds and test reverse reconstruction on the unseen fifth fold.
design.rule_model: Context-conditioned substitution/deletion rules plus boundary-conditioned insertions, backed off to cell-level rules. Rules must meet fixed support/confidence thresholds; otherwise identity is preserved.
design.null: Learn the same reverse model after deterministically rotating ancestor targets among meanings within the training set.
design.meaning_control: Compare the matched historical ancestor with a wrong-meaning ancestor under the full fixed Man-grid operator family.
design.all_languages_boundary: Languages without an explicit inherited historical form cannot yield a transformation rule, but they are still scanned; no language or language family is hard-coded into or excluded from the test.
design.representation: Historical spellings are mapped through the same fixed 4×4 gate encoder. This measures reproducible structural sound/spelling drift; it is not a claim that every spelling is an exact historical IPA transcription.
